      <div class="accordioContentWrapper">
        <div class="accordionTitle d-flex pt-20 pb-20 pl-15 pr-25 justifyBetween alignCenter">
          <h6>Infrastructure</h6>        
        </div>
        <div class="accordionAnsWrapper p-30">
          <p><strong>Cloud infrastructure</strong><span></span><br><span>All of our services run in the cloud. We don’t host or run our own routers, load balancers, DNS servers, or physical servers. Our service is built on Amazon Web Services. They provide strong security measures to protect our infrastructure and are compliant with most certifications. You can read more about their practices here: </span><a href="https://aws.amazon.com/security/">AWS</a></p>
        </div>
      </div>      
            
      <div class="accordioContentWrapper">
        <div class="accordionTitle d-flex pt-20 pb-20 pl-15 pr-25 justifyBetween alignCenter">
          <h6>Network level security monitoring and protection</h6>        
        </div>
        <div class="accordionAnsWrapper p-30">
          <p><span>Our network security architecture consists of multiple security zones. We monitor and protect our network, to make sure no unauthorized access is performed using:</span></p>
<ul>
<li>A virtual private cloud (VPC), a bastion host or VPN with network access control lists (ACLs) and no public IP addresses.</li>
<li>A firewall that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic.</li>
<li>IP address filtering</li>
</ul>
        </div>
      </div>      
            
      <div class="accordioContentWrapper">
        <div class="accordionTitle d-flex pt-20 pb-20 pl-15 pr-25 justifyBetween alignCenter">
          <h6>Data Encryption</h6>        
        </div>
        <div class="accordionAnsWrapper p-30">
          <p><span>Encryption in transit: All data sent to or from our infrastructure is encrypted in transit via industry best-practices using Transport Layer Security (TLS). You can see our SSLLabs report </span><a href="https://www.ssllabs.com/ssltest/analyze.html?d=codacy.com">here</a><span> Encryption at rest: All our user data is encrypted using battled-proofed encryption algorithms in the database.</span></p>
        </div>
      </div>      
            
      <div class="accordioContentWrapper">
        <div class="accordionTitle d-flex pt-20 pb-20 pl-15 pr-25 justifyBetween alignCenter">
          <h6>Data retention and removal</h6>        
        </div>
        <div class="accordionAnsWrapper p-30">
          <p><span>We retain your usage data after your trial. Every user can request the removal of usage data by contacting support or deleting his account. Read more about our privacy settings at </span><a href="https://www.codacy.com/privacy?hsLang=en">codacy.com/privacy</a><span>.</span></p>
        </div>
      </div>      
            
      <div class="accordioContentWrapper">
        <div class="accordionTitle d-flex pt-20 pb-20 pl-15 pr-25 justifyBetween alignCenter">
          <h6>Business continuity and disaster recovery</h6>        
        </div>
        <div class="accordionAnsWrapper p-30">
          <p><span>We back up all our critical assets and regularly attempt to restore the backup to guarantee a fast recovery in case of disaster. All our backups are encrypted.</span></p>
        </div>
      </div>      
            
      <div class="accordioContentWrapper">
        <div class="accordionTitle d-flex pt-20 pb-20 pl-15 pr-25 justifyBetween alignCenter">
          <h6>Application security monitoring</h6>        
        </div>
        <div class="accordionAnsWrapper p-30">
          <ul>
<li>We use a security monitoring solution to get visibility into our application security, identify attacks and respond quickly to a data breach.</li>
<li>We use technologies to monitor exceptions, logs and detect anomalies in our applications.</li>
<li>We collect and store logs to provide an audit trail of our applications activity.</li>
<li>We use monitoring such as open tracing in our microservices.</li>
</ul>
        </div>
      </div>      
            
      <div class="accordioContentWrapper">
        <div class="accordionTitle d-flex pt-20 pb-20 pl-15 pr-25 justifyBetween alignCenter">
          <h6>Secure development</h6>        
        </div>
        <div class="accordionAnsWrapper p-30">
          <p><span>We develop following security best practices and frameworks (OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25). We use the following best practices to ensure the highest level of security in our software:</span></p>
<ul>
<li>Developers participate in regular security training to learn about common vulnerabilities and threats</li>
<li>We review our code for security vulnerabilities</li>
<li>We regularly update our dependencies and make sure none of them has known vulnerabilities</li>
<li>We use Static Application Security Testing (SAST) to detect basic security vulnerabilities in our codebase</li>
<li>We use Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) to scan our applications</li>
</ul>
        </div>
      </div>      
            
      <div class="accordioContentWrapper">
        <div class="accordionTitle d-flex pt-20 pb-20 pl-15 pr-25 justifyBetween alignCenter">
          <h6>Responsible disclosure</h6>        
        </div>
        <div class="accordionAnsWrapper p-30">
          <p>We encourage everyone to practice responsible disclosure and comply with our policies and terms of service to participate in our bug bounty program.
